item.title: DJ Cal — Fri Jul 31, 10:00 PM — Perch + Plow
item.description:
Raised in the Bay Area, DJ Cal has gained a reputation for doing multi-genre set lists designed to move the crowds with a blend of Trap, EDM,Hip-Hop and Reggaeton music. He calls the city of Santa Rosa his home, but you might’ve heard his mixes on-air across the nation \(San Francisco, Las Vegas, Orlando, Palms Springs, etc.\). He currently holds a spot as a Mixshow DJ on Fresno California B95, with Teezzy Radio, Last Call and Friday night street party. DJ CAL has several Bay Area and Northern California venues under his belt and you can catch him performing and hanging out with the hottest names in music around the Bay. He also has created his own day party, "Brunch Behavior" that has gained much popularity in the North Bay. Also, his work has been supported and featured by various blogs, websites and record pools; DJ City, MyMP3Pool, BpmSupreme and SmashTheClub, and more. DJ CAL has worked hard to make his own mark in the music industry.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Kendra Morris & Monophonics — Sat Aug 1, 2:30 PM — HopMonk Tavern
item.description:
With a timeless sound that blends heavy soul and psych-rock, Monophonics have built a reputation over the past decade as one of the best live bands in the country. Led by singer Kelly Finnigan, the band of has drawn on their colorful history — both their experiences as veteran touring performers and as individuals growing up in the Bay Area — to create “It’s Only Us,” their fourth release since 2012, out on Colemine Records.
A reflection of what they see as the current state of the world, the record touches on difficult subjects such as broken relationships, mental health issues, gun violence and power struggles, all with an underlying message of unity, resilience and acceptance. The band’s signature style of arrangement — leaning on warm textures, thanks to rhythm and horn sections whose reputations precede them — has been expanded with top-notch production and creative instrumentation: a Mellotron, lap steel guitar, harp and Moog all round out the Monophonics’ trademark soul sou

item.description:
"Drawing on influences ranging from the British Invasion to pub rock to the paisley underground, the band blends an array of guitar sounds with clever lyricism." - Glide Magazine
Formed by veterans of the California roots scene, New Earth Farmers features Paul Michael Knowles \(vocals/guitars/keyboards/bass\), Nicole Storto \(vocals/guitar\), and Nigel Twist \(the original founding drummer of The Alarm\). They are frequently joined by James DePrato \(guitar\), Kevin T. White \(bass\), Jeff LeGore \(bass\) and Melissa Phillips-DePrato on harmony vocals. Their music has been known for blending Americana, 70s style rock and folk rock. The sound is expanding to incorporate hints of funk and soul on this new effort with subconscious comparisons to artists like World Party, Staple Singers, Curtis Mayfield, and George Harrison. item.title: Collector's Cellar at The Lodge at Dawn Ranch with Thatcher’s Wines — Sat Aug 8, 5:00 PM — The Lodge at Dawn Ranch
item.description:
This summer, The Lodge at Dawn Ranch is elevating the wine dinner beyond pairings and pours with the launch of **Collector's Cellar,** an ongoing series offering guests access to rare bottles, acclaimed producers, historic wineries and collaborations typically reserved for collectors and wine industry insiders.
On August 8 from 5-8pm, guests can experience a special dinner in collaboration with Thatcher’s Wines, one of California’s most exciting boutique wine importers. Award-winning sommelier **Thatcher Baker-Briggs** will lead guests through six courses and six tastings. The series is designed to deepen guests’ connection to the stories, philosophies, and craftsmanship behind the glass, bringing together pioneering winemakers and singular wines that reflect a distinct sense of place and identity.

item.description:

item.title: Shut Up & Write!™ Santa Rosa REMOTE ZOOM FRIDAY — Fri Aug 14, 3:00 PM
item.description:
Shut Up & Write!® Wine Country **This event is hosted on the Shut Up & Write website, so please [sign up here](https://shutupwrite.com/series/shut-up-write-online-with-lorraine-s/7480) for your writing event.**
**ABOUT THE EVENT** Welcome! I will email passcode to those who register. Be sure to enable email on MeetUp! Then, please check your email! Join us virtually for an hour + of writing using Zoom. Let's keep together as much as we can during these uncertain times and keep on writing. Look for the schedule online and join us.
We’ve discovered that it’s strikingly helpful to write with other writers. See if it’s true for you at 3pm on Friday afternoon. Be it a book, blog, script, essay, dissertation, resume, melody, poem or just plain work stuff, you are invited to write it with us. No one will see what you've written or give you unsolicited advice. Instead of just thinking about writing, come and get some real writing done.
JOIN US!

item.title: APA Pool League Game Night Extravaganza! — Wed Aug 19, 7:00 PM
item.description:
Apa Pool League Join us for an exciting evening of pool at the APA Pool League Night Extravaganza! Whether you are a seasoned pro or a beginner, this event is open to all players looking to have a fun time. Get ready to showcase your billiards skills, learn new strategies, and meet fellow pool enthusiasts. This is the perfect opportunity to socialize, enjoy friendly competition, and immerse yourself in the thrilling world of pool leagues.
Don't miss out on the chance to be part of the Apa Pool League community as we come together for a night filled with games, camaraderie, and good times. Whether you're interested in testing your skills, learning from others, or simply having a blast, this event has something for everyone. Grab your cue, chalk up your pool stick, and get ready for an unforgettable gaming experience with APA Pool League!
Source: Sonoma County APA Pool League
